notable_drops: OfficeRnD (all roles) - careers page says 'hiring for various engineering, sales and customer services positions' but the jobs widget never renders and no ATS board is reachable (Workable widget API 404s). The single best domain match in the slice and it has no fetchable posting. Worth him emailing careers@officernd.com directly citing the OfficeRnD API integration.
Nexudus (all roles) - /careers/ resolves to the product homepage, no listings. No board exists.
Spacebring Junior Front-end Developer / Junior Node.js Developer - Lviv on-site and junior, a step back from Lead Developer; their Customer Support/Success Manager is Latin America only.
deskbird (6 roles) - zero engineering/product roles open; everything is DACH demand-gen, accounting or US sales, and the two remote roles are 'Remote - Germany' only.
Casavo - board returns 'No jobs found' across all 8 departments (Tech included). Not hiring.
Tidio - careers.tidio.com/open-roles renders no postings; can't verify anything.
Enterprise Bot 'AI Solutions Engineer - Europe' - returns HTTP 410, posting withdrawn. Of the live board only Zurich Customer Success and Bengaluru hybrid roles remain (India delivery centre).

Parloa Forward Deployed Engineer x6 - every FDE variant is 'Remotely in Germany' (Berlin/Munich) or 'Remotely in the USA'; no EU-wide or Italy-eligible option, and the (f/m/d) German-market postings imply DACH delivery.

Gorgias Data Scientist - LLM (Paris) and Senior Backend Engineer (Belgrade) - '6+ years' on the backend role, Paris on-site for the LLM role, and Manager/Implementation is Buenos Aires. Nothing mid-level and EU-remote.
Sierra - all engineering/solutions roles are San Francisco on-site at $230-390k senior bands despite London/Paris/Madrid/Munich offices existing.
Decagon - Senior Solutions Engineer and all engineering roles San Francisco on-site, no EMEA postings.

Cognigy (NiCE) - Dusseldorf-based Staff Software Engineer / VP Engineering / MLOps / Senior QA only; staff-plus or specialist, plus a Senior DACH Marketing role. No implementation or solutions engineering opening.
Cresta Solutions Engineer, EMEA - '5+ years customer-facing incl. 1-3 in pre-sales' at GBP 145,000-162,500 base; enterprise pre-sales with Genesys/Five9/SIP/SBC/IVR depth he cannot evidence.
Cresta Forward Deployed Product Manager - AI Agent (EMEA) - '5+ years in Technology Consulting, Implementations, Product or Customer Success' AND requires unrestricted UK work authorisation.
Siena AI - only Europe-touching role is a Product Manager published 2025-09-17 (11 months stale); its Software Engineer is Argentina/LATAM-only.

NICE 'AI Solution Strategist' UK-Remote and 'Delivery Solutions Architect (Conversation Designer)' Germany-Remote - listed on the EU board but the posting URLs 302 off-host to nice.com/careers/apply, so neither could be verified as a single live posting.

Robin / Envoy / OfficeSpace Software / Yardi Kube / Optix / Archie / Cobot / Matterport - no reachable job board surfaced under domain-restricted search; their content ranks as marketing/comparison blog posts, which is what ate the search budget.

rows.title: Full-Stack Engineer (Web & APIs)
rows.location: Remote — primary Paris, France; secondary locations across Europe
rows.why: The Flex is a London-founded flexible short-stay accommodation platform — instant bookable serviced apartments by day/week/month — which is the same booking-and-inventory problem he automated at FlowSpace via the Office RnD and Nexudus integrations, and he grew that coworking marketplace from 2,000 to 4,500+ users. Role is web + API work on a flex-space booking product, no year count stated.
rows.watch_outs: Backend is FastAPI/Python + React + AWS — his shipped stack is TypeScript/Next.js/Laravel, so the Python side is the gap to address in the cover letter. Posted 29 Jan 2026 and still listed (isListed=true), so it may be a slow-burn req. Ashby HTML page is a JS shell; apply through the board link. No explicit eligibility sentence — confirm they can engage someone Italy-based before investing time.

rows.title: Founding Engineer
rows.location: Remote-first — primary Paris, France; secondary locations across Europe
rows.why: Same flex-accommodation domain: his Office RnD/Nexudus booking automations and commute-time calculator are exactly the surface a founding engineer on a short-stay booking platform owns, and the 2,000 to 4,500 user growth number is the product-ownership evidence a founding role screens for.
rows.watch_outs: 'Founding Engineer' at a scaling startup usually means senior autonomy — pitch the Bubble.io to Next.js/Laravel migration ownership rather than year count. Four engineering reqs published the same day (Founding, Lead, Senior, Full-Stack) suggests a team build-out; apply to one and mention flexibility on level. Description truncated in the API read, so requirements are only partly known.

rows.title: AI Deployment Manager, EMEA
rows.comp: Not disclosed — 'competitive, location-based pay', Base + Bonus + Equity
rows.why: Cresta is contact-centre AI — deploying AI agents that handle customer conversations, which is the production customer-support agents he shipped, on the vendor side. The posting asks for 'technical or AI-driven SaaS implementations' plus project management and states no year requirement, so his forward-deployed delivery pattern is the whole job.
rows.watch_outs: 'United Kingdom (Remote)' — his Italian EU long-term residence permit does not give UK work rights, and Cresta's sibling EMEA postings explicitly ask 'are you legally authorized to work in the country where this role is based without restriction?'. Ask up front whether they can engage an EU-based contractor or run EOR; if not it becomes a sponsorship application. Also more delivery-management than hands-on build.

rows.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
rows.location: Dublin, Ireland — hybrid, 3 days/week in office
rows.why: Fin is Intercom's AI customer-support agent, so the production support agents he shipped are the product itself; a forward-deployed engineer there builds and tunes those agents inside customer environments, which matches his API-integration-plus-agent pattern (OpenAI, Eden AI, n8n, CRM lead capture). The posting states no years-of-experience requirement.
rows.watch_outs: Relocation to Dublin — 'we expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week', not remote-eligible. Intercom lists Senior and Staff variants of this title, so this is the entry rung of a high-bar loop, and the JD prefers a 'CS, Mathematics, Software Engineering or Physics' background against his BA Philosophy. As an EU long-term resident he can move to Ireland but needs a local permit step.
